note: Observed data only. No value is a share of operated flights.

conditions.touching: a flight counts for a scope when its origin or destination lies in it
conditions.daily metrics: world and continents only (daily counts by country are not in the dataset)

method: {"analysis": {"anomaly_days": "days flagged against the same-weekday baseline; use to exclude or annotate days", "gap_hours": "worldwide hours with (almost) no flights; attributable to data collection", "daily_cv": "day-to-day variation of observed volume within a month (stability of the record)", "tier_shares": "mix of airport evidence (T1-T4) for flights touching the scope", "callsign_only_end_share": "share of airport ends assigned from the callsign route only (R4): a risk flag", "route_persistence_share": "share of the scope's routes observed in >= 6 of the months in the data", "mom_change_observed": "month-on-month change of OBSERVED flights; read together with anomaly days"}, "reference_only": {"observed_flights": "volume in the data; NOT a share of operated flights (no denominator)", "track_end_share": "share of ends supported by the track (R1/R2); NOT a capture rate", "cross_scope_volume_comparison": "regions differ in receiver density; volumes are not comparable as traffic"}}
